global_activation_order: Create an exact source commit and record the current database schema and compatibility state.
Create and restore-test a backup before a phase can mutate durable state.
Enable one control at a time for a bounded canary cohort.
Compare privacy-safe canonical and compatibility counts, mismatches, failures, and latency.
Promote to default-on only after API, CLI, UI, provider, restart, and rollback gates pass.
Retire compatibility behavior only after supported-window use reaches zero and rollback evidence is retained.
global_rollback_invariants: Schema migrations are forward-only. Disabling a feature never runs an automatic down migration.
A database restore is an explicit offline recovery from a verified backup, never an in-place flag side effect.
Rollback does not delete canonical records, accepted evidence, audit events, dirty worktrees, artifacts, or user-authored content.

Active jobs and provider sessions are drained, paused, or stopped under their original provider, billing mode, workspace, and authorization; rollback never silently substitutes a provider or billing mode.
Rollback never revives expired sessions, stale assignments, revoked device credentials, or reusable master-token remote bootstrap.
Every control change records actor, exact source commit, prior and next state, reason, cohort, timestamp, and verification result without credential or sensitive-content values.
Emergency kill switches fail closed for the new surface while preserving local operator recovery and read-only evidence inspection.

excluded_operational_controls.name: ORCHESTRA_NO_AUTH
excluded_operational_controls.reason: Development-only authentication bypass; it is never an Agent OS migration rollback.

excluded_operational_controls.name: ORCHESTRA_AUTOWAKE
excluded_operational_controls.reason: Scheduling behavior toggle; disabling it does not select a canonical or compatibility data authority.

excluded_operational_controls.name: ORCHESTRA_AUTOSHIP
excluded_operational_controls.reason: Workflow automation toggle; disabling it is not a schema or authority rollback.

excluded_operational_controls.name: ORCHESTRA_VERBOSE_RULES
excluded_operational_controls.reason: Prompt-output comparison control; it is not an Agent OS phase migration.

excluded_operational_controls.name: ORCHESTRA_VERBOSE_OUTPUT
excluded_operational_controls.reason: Prompt-output rollback control; it is not an Agent OS phase migration.

phases.name: Product contract and baseline
phases.activation_gate: A documented exact baseline commit reproduces tests, builds, package smoke, state inventory, and dirty-checkout exclusions.

rollback.checkpoint: Last reviewed baseline commit and its retained evidence bundle.
triggers: Inventory or dirty-checkout scope is incomplete
actions: Keep the baseline gate closed
Revert only the unaccepted contract delta
Regenerate evidence from the last trusted commit
verification: No runtime or database state changed
Previous baseline commands still reproduce
rollback.data_policy: Documentation-only rollback; no durable application data is mutated.

phases.name: Canonical domain and event ledger
phases.activation_gate: Canonical schemas, backfills, causal metadata, integrity queries, and compatibility projections pass upgrade and restart tests.

rollback.checkpoint: Pre-canonical-write database backup plus the last compatible application commit.
actions: Disable new canonical entrypoints
Return compatibility routes to their prior authority
Preserve canonical rows for diagnosis and forward repair
verification: Legacy reads remain coherent
No canonical row is deleted or rewritten by flag rollback
rollback.data_policy: Keep forward schema and canonical evidence; restore a backup only through explicit offline recovery.

phases.name: Canonical orchestration
phases.activation_gate: Board, CLI, and API create the same frozen contract/workspace/session/job/delivery lifecycle with idempotent dispatch.
telemetry: Launch mismatch and rejection reason counts

rollback.checkpoint: Exact commit and database backup before enabling canonical Board launch.
actions: Unset ORCHESTRA_CANONICAL_LAUNCH for new Board launches
Leave canonical API and CLI entrypoints explicit
Drain or recover existing jobs under their frozen identity
verification: New compatibility launches return the legacy envelope
Existing canonical jobs remain inspectable and are not relaunched
rollback.data_policy: Do not delete frozen lifecycle rows or reuse their idempotency keys.

phases.name: Durable Agent Home and conversation
phases.activation_gate: Conversation, provider events, controls, forks, retention, search, export, and restart recovery pass with redaction.
telemetry: Agent Home versus compatibility transcript reads

rollback.checkpoint: Pre-default Agent Home database backup and export/replay evidence.
triggers: Control action targets the wrong session
actions: Route new navigation back to compatibility surfaces
Disable new Agent Home mutations
Keep canonical history available read-only for diagnosis
verification: No conversation event or fork lineage is deleted
Existing provider sessions retain their original control scope
rollback.data_policy: Canonical conversation history remains authoritative and forward-readable.

phases.name: Terminal and workspace parity
phases.activation_gate: Real PTY, cwd/worktree binding, geometry, signals, reconnect, command history, package tools, and mobile read-only controls pass.

rollback.checkpoint: Last version with proven PTY and workspace attachment semantics.
actions: Disable new terminal-binding behavior for new processes
Keep existing PTYs attached until stopped or drained
Return remote terminal controls to view-only
verification: No process is moved to another workspace
Dirty worktrees and terminal output are preserved
rollback.data_policy: Never delete a worktree, command record, or PTY evidence as a rollback side effect.

phases.name: Contracts and Job Market
phases.activation_gate: Contract validation, dependency rules, Open Work, matching, claim/assign/reassign, and exactly-one-job dispatch pass.
telemetry: Publish, claim, match, and assignment outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Last compatible contract/assignment schema and verified database backup.
actions: Stop new publication and matching
Keep contracts and assignments readable
Drain existing jobs under frozen versions
verification: No assignment is silently transferred
Published versions and audit history remain immutable
rollback.data_policy: Forward-fix contracts and assignments; do not down-migrate or rewrite accepted history.

phases.name: Delivery and evidence trackbook
phases.activation_gate: Criteria, verifier commands, artifact hashes, requested-versus-delivered review, rejection, resubmission, override, and shipped records pass.

rollback.checkpoint: Last accepted delivery schema and immutable evidence snapshot.
triggers: Evidence associated with the wrong criterion
actions: Disable automatic canonical review transitions
Require manual review on existing immutable evidence
Keep compatibility presentation read-only
verification: Accepted evidence and override attribution are unchanged
No generic git history is promoted to a shipped record
rollback.data_policy: Evidence is append-only; rollback can stop new automation but cannot erase or mutate accepted proof.

phases.name: Knowledge Compiler
phases.activation_gate: Each stage independently passes provenance, freshness, redaction, deterministic ranking, token budget, citation, and with/without-context benchmarks.
telemetry: Sources/chunks considered, selected, rejected, and refreshed
Per-section estimated and actual token use

rollback.checkpoint: Content-addressed source/chunk/build snapshot before enabling the next stage.
actions: Disable injection first, then compilation and retrieval as needed
Keep verified ingestion records for review
Run managed jobs without compiled context rather than injecting unproven material
verification: Prompt contains no disabled context section
Stored source provenance and context-use audit remain intact
rollback.data_policy: Forgetting or superseding knowledge is an explicit reviewed action, not a flag rollback.

phases.name: Discussions and Q&A
phases.activation_gate: Nested posts, states, accepted answers, search, explicit subscriptions, provenance, permissions, loop prevention, and reviewed knowledge promotion pass.
telemetry: Posts, explicit recipient wakes, and loop-prevention outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Last verified discussion schema and accepted-answer export.
triggers: Automated reply loop or unintended fanout
actions: Disable promotion and agent writes before reads
Stop discussion-generated wakes
Retain discussions read-only with provenance
verification: No accepted answer or resolution is removed
No disabled discussion wakes an agent
rollback.data_policy: Discussion history is retained; moderation and forgetting remain explicit audited commands.

phases.name: Teams and conflicts
phases.activation_gate: Explicit membership, roles, bounded rounds/budgets, proposals, synthesis, delegation, conflict evidence, human override, and integrated delivery pass.
telemetry: Participant, wake, token, cost, and round budgets

rollback.checkpoint: Pre-team planning snapshot with independent job/assignment ownership.
actions: Stop new rounds, delegation, and enforcement
Preserve proposals and conflict evidence read-only
Return unresolved work to explicit human assignment
verification: No agent remains implicitly enrolled
Advisory leases do not become enforcement after rollback
rollback.data_policy: Keep team/conflict audit and integrated deliveries; never rewrite participant positions.

phases.name: Provider-neutral tools and permissions
phases.activation_gate: Exact provider/version/platform/account/billing/capability evidence and approval/permission drift tests pass independently for each provider route.
telemetry: Provider route selection and blocker counts
Effective capability and permission drift counts
Approval, tool, usage, and recovery outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Last exact accepted provider tuple, matrix digest, source commit, and adapter package.
triggers: Version, billing, credential, or capability mismatch
actions: Disable only the affected provider contract route for new sessions
Drain or stop active sessions under their frozen provider and billing mode
Restore the last accepted adapter tuple only after its exact evidence is revalidated
verification: No provider or billing mode is substituted
Unsupported routes fail visibly before native dispatch
rollback.data_policy: Provider acceptance evidence remains append-only; rollback never copies, logs, or exports provider credentials.

phases.name: Unified visual command center
phases.activation_gate: Navigation, canonical detail surfaces, deep links, search, states, responsive layouts, accessibility, and terminal controls pass together.

rollback.checkpoint: Last verified Board/Agent Home navigation build and deep-link inventory.
triggers: Canonical detail points to inconsistent state
actions: Return navigation to existing Board and Agent Home routes
Keep new detail routes directly addressable for diagnosis
Preserve selected IDs in redirect parameters
verification: Existing deep links still resolve
No canonical data is mutated by UI rollback
rollback.data_policy: UI rollback changes presentation and routing only; canonical records remain unchanged.

phases.name: Token efficiency and outcome analytics
phases.activation_gate: Provider-normalized attribution, privacy review, budgets, quality-aware benchmarks, and dashboard calculations pass.
telemetry: Token, time, evidence, and quality aggregates

rollback.checkpoint: Pre-capture privacy schema and pre-dashboard aggregate snapshot.
actions: Disable display before capture when presentation alone is wrong
Stop new capture when privacy or attribution is wrong
Retain only already-approved redacted aggregates
verification: No disabled analytics write occurs
Runtime success never depends on analytics availability
rollback.data_policy: Analytics rollback does not alter provider transcripts, jobs, contracts, or deliveries.

phases.name: Secure remote and mobile control
phases.activation_gate: Independent pairing, device-auth, scope, tunnel, terminal-write, push, offline, revocation, abuse, platform, and accessibility gates pass.
telemetry: Tunnel, terminal-write, push, and kill-switch outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Local-only build, DeviceSession credential inventory, service-worker cache version, and verified tunnel ownership state.
triggers: Revocation, offline, tunnel, terminal, or cache safety failure
actions: Activate remote.kill_switch and stop accepting remote requests
Stop verified Orchestra-owned tunnels
Revoke device credentials, streams, grants, push subscriptions, and authenticated caches
Keep the local loopback operator surface available
verification: Remote endpoints fail closed while local recovery works
Rollback does not restore a reusable master-token QR
Terminal write returns to view-only
rollback.data_policy: Retain redacted audit attribution; never restore revoked device credentials or authenticated cached content.

phases.name: Reliability, security, and operations
phases.activation_gate: Crash/restart, orphan reconciliation, backup/restore, retention, authorization, rate limits, diagnostics, metrics, alerts, capacity, shutdown, and security review pass.
telemetry: Recovery, queue, provider, projection, and disk/database health
Backup, restore, retention, and diagnostics outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Restore-tested database and state-root backup plus last operationally supported package.
actions: Stop new automated maintenance or rollout
Quiesce active work before package rollback
Restore only through the verified offline recovery procedure
verification: Database integrity and migration checksums pass
No active job or owned worktree is duplicated or erased
rollback.data_policy: Never use a flag to down-migrate a live database or recursively remove the Orchestra state root.

phases.name: Testing and quality gates
phases.activation_gate: Every state machine, migration, provider, PTY, lifecycle, knowledge, team, remote, accessibility, performance, dogfood, and clean-install gate passes at one exact commit.
telemetry: Flake, retry, performance, and acceptance history

rollback.checkpoint: Last exact commit with a complete retained green evidence bundle.
triggers: Required gate fails or lacks evidence
Evidence belongs to another source commit
actions: Keep the release gate closed
Revert or fix the failing change
Rerun the complete evidence set at the resulting exact commit
verification: No narrower test substitutes for the failed broad gate
Artifacts and source commit hashes match
rollback.data_policy: Quality rollback blocks promotion; it does not mutate production data.

phases.name: Onboarding, packaging, and documentation
phases.activation_gate: Clean install/upgrade/uninstall, provider onboarding, safe defaults, backup/reset, troubleshooting, API docs, privacy, and support workflow pass from the retained package.

rollback.checkpoint: Last retained installable package and its compatible data-version range.
triggers: Documentation or telemetry consent is false
actions: Withdraw the affected package/onboarding cohort
Return users to the prior compatible package
Keep user state and explicit telemetry preference
verification: Prior package opens the existing forward-compatible state
No uninstall or rollback deletes user state
rollback.data_policy: Package rollback preserves state; incompatible database restore requires the explicit offline recovery path.

phases.name: Public release and rollout
phases.activation_gate: Exact release artifact, every declared provider, clean platforms, security, dogfood, diagnostics, rollback, support, and staged beta criteria pass.
telemetry: Install, provider, recovery, migration, and rollback outcomes

rollback.checkpoint: Previous signed/provenance-verified release, migration compatibility range, and rollback drill.
triggers: Unsafe provider, auth, migration, or remote behavior
actions: Stop promotion and new cohort enrollment
Withdraw the affected artifact without deleting local state
Publish a verified hotfix or prior-compatible package
verification: Rollback/hotfix provenance is valid
Existing user state and revocations remain intact
rollback.data_policy: Release rollback is a package/channel action; database recovery remains explicit and forward-safe.

phases.name: Explicitly deferred scope
phases.activation_gate: A separate decision records prerequisite completion, scope, threat/budget analysis, rollout controls, and evidence before any deferred capability enters implementation.

rollback.checkpoint: Stable core release before the deferred capability is admitted.
triggers: Scope or safety evidence is incomplete
actions: Keep or return the deferred-scope gate to closed
Remove the capability from active rollout
Preserve only explicitly reviewed data and audit evidence
verification: Core behavior is unchanged
No deferred capability remains silently enabled
rollback.data_policy: Deferred capabilities receive their own migration and recovery contract before they may create authoritative data.
